format: Filtered native Codex JSONL with original source_line; authentic messages and tool calls/results retained
scope: Snapshots before evidence commit; final commit/checkpoint pairing is supplied by Entire automatically
filtering: Omit developer/system instructions, reasoning, duplicate event streams, world state and token telemetry; retain user/assistant messages, tool calls/results, session identifier and model/effort. Replace home/workspace paths, credential-shaped strings, email addresses and SSN-shaped identifiers. Fixture identifiers are redacted too.
